authorization.scope: Approved N0/NL review plan: CPU implementation, Train-only feasibility and Sol review; subsequent GPU engineering and scientific training separately authorized.
authorization.dispatch: Existing Luna conversation reads A7 STATUS; no new Luna conversation created.

roles.Sol: Freeze approved CPU card, source preflight, scientific review and gate recommendations
roles.Luna: Implement and execute bounded CPU checks in existing conversation; report actual results to STATUS

question: Relative to standard nnU-Net N0, can local balanced absolute positive/negative CE improve frozen hemorrhage-neighborhood thin-skeleton d1 recall with acceptable quality cost? No lesion specificity claim without NR.

target.positive: Reuse native Zhang skeleton(GT & FOV), padded 2*EDT <= 3, frozen Rnear/Omega; no d1 dilation, no Dev-derived targets
target.negative: Same native Rnear/Omega, not complete GT; Euclidean distance to complete GT in [2,8], distance to positive <=12 native pixels

sampling.zero_negative_action: Skip whole positive group; no positive-only/negative-only fallback
sampling.order: Map native identities using actual sampled geometry; retain transformed valid GT/domain and background; remove collisions; choose <=16 valid positive groups uniformly; choose min(2,available) unique negatives uniformly
sampling.RNG: numpy Generator PCG64 SeedSequence([20261031, model_seed, one_based_attempt, crop_index]); private stream, never shared with native loader/augmentation/model RNG
sampling.across_positive_negative_reuse: Allowed, count and report; one negative may receive weights from different positive groups
sampling.collision: Deduplicate each polarity by transformed pixel; lowest original (y,x) identity wins, no replacement targets; opposite-label collision invalidates that group

loss.expected_logits_shape: [B,2,H,W]; actual highest-resolution output selected by verified native order/shape
loss.crop: mean(group_loss) over selected valid positives; empty crop graph-connected finite zero
loss.calculation: FP32 stable logits softplus; no probability clipping; lambda==0 bypass before aux computation

CPU.native_replay: Actual baseline loader and transforms, original worker seed semantics and train-prefetch discard; compare first 1000 actual ID/inputSHA/targetSHA per seed against immutable historical attempts.jsonl. No native model construction or checkpoint loading.
CPU.visible_denominator: All original native positive identities mapped inside final output before GT/domain rejection, negative availability, collision filtering and 16-positive cap; each identity once per crop. Do not silently replace by eligible/successful targets.
CPU.retained_numerator: Selected unique valid positive groups after all mapping, validity, negative and cap checks
CPU.effective_images: Per image mass=sum(1/B) over nonempty auxiliary crops from that image; normalize masses to w_i. Neff=1/sum(w_i^2). This is loss coefficient exposure, NOT measured parameter-gradient contribution.
hard_stop: Resource cap reached; retain partial evidence, no automatic rerun
CPU.diagnostics: Report all110 images, zeros, all351 target identities, pre/post cap, per-stage exclusion causes, three native sizes, top-image concentration, negative reuse; native coverage is not augmented exposure
synthetic_tests: Duplicate identities and cross-polarity collision rejection
lambda0 bypass including invalid auxiliary metadata
CPU.atlas: Deterministic first qualifying examples for native sizes, empty target, one/two/zero surviving negatives, border, mapping collision and cap. Missing strata explicitly NA; no selecting visually favorable outcomes.

future_lambda.selection: First32 nonempty actualTrain batches in frozen CPU trace, before any model-dependent selection
future_lambda.gradient: All trainable parameters, true unscaled preclip gradients at original seed2027 initialization; model parameters never updated during calibration
future_lambda.abnormal: Stop if zero/invalid denominator or nonfinite; no automatic clipping/retuning of lambda

future_engineering.zero_coeff_replay: N0 and lambda0 each16 updates for each of seeds2027/2028:64 attempts
future_engineering.restore: NL32 continuous versus16+16 interrupted fixed-input replay:64 attempts; fresh original initialization, no Dev
future_engineering.AMP: Original verified safe-skip policy: consecutive5 or cumulative25 pause; no catch-up updates; nonfinite/unknown fatal
future_engineering.native_queue_resume: Unsupported unless separately proved; fixed-input resume test does not establish queue resume

future_science.initialization: Fresh corresponding official nnU-Net random seed; match historical N0 initialization digest. Never M0 or N0 endpoint weights.
future_science.base_configuration: Original PlainConvUNet CE+Dice deep supervision/SGD .01 momentum.99 Nesterov wd3e-5/Poly100 exponent.9/clip12/native AMP/Train-only monitors unchanged
future_science.paired_baseline: Reuse N0 only if initialization, actualseed, lambda0 and all scientific input/GT/ID/LR pairing verified; otherwise stop and request budget decision, no automatic N0 rerun
future_science.endpoint_inference: 28 Dev images/67 native tiles per seed; no TTA/ensemble/postprocess/intermediate Dev; separate final inference budget
future_science.GPU_assignment: Resource access rechecked at later release; old GPU permissions are not assumed

evaluation.status: Approved design for future candidate; not amendment to historical protocols; full scientific card/release pending
evaluation.primary_signal: Eachseed mean NL-N0 >0 AND lower bound of pooled-within-image-across-seeds paired95CI >0
evaluation.Dice_guard: Eachseed image-mean NL-N0 >=0 as conservative point-estimate screen; report CI separately, no proof of no degradation from nonsignificance
evaluation.local_FP_primary: Image macro FP/(frozen Rnear & Omega area),18 original nonempty images; same fixed support
evaluation.local_FP_guard: Eachseed mean delta<=0; pooled paired CI upper<=0 needed for interval-level no-increase evidence; crossing0 uncertain
local_FP_supplements: per-image and pooled totals, separate from macro
auxiliary: leave-one-image-out sensitivity, not deletion or replacement primary
limitations: Two seeds do not create independent patients
Original thin-point definition not anatomical whole-branch guarantee
No NR so no lesion specificity
GT-relative automatic results not expert medical verification
result_categories: Local gain and point/interval guard evidence separately stated
